name: British Lichen Society: Ecological or Conservation Research and Survey grants
summary: Grants for fieldwork and survey on notable or threatened lichens and their habitats, where the work improves understanding of their conservation and management. Members and non-members can apply.
reporting: A detailed report on the work to the BLS Conservation Officer.

access.quote: Both non-members and members of the BLS are eligible to apply.

amount.quote: The British Lichen Society invites applications for between £1,000 and £5,000 for research and fieldwork on notable or threatened lichens and their habitats

co_finance_required.quote: Although not essential the BLS encourages the applicants to seek other contributions

reporting.quote: A detailed report on the work should be produced and sent to the BLS Conservation Officer
